result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position. It ambiguously provides both renewal only by mutual written agreement and automatic renewal, conflicts with Sections II and III, and requires 90 days’ notice, exceeding the 60-day fallback maximum. It also omits the required price-increase cap and, for the preferred automatic-renewal option, the Customer’s 30-day opt-out and Vendor reminder. Adding an auto-renewal alternative was unnecessary because a clear mutual-written-agreement renewal provision would have satisfied the preferred position.
